prompt: Create a single self-contained SVG (600x400) that visualizes the following: a 5x5 grid of cells (each 60x60 px, grid placed at x=60..360, y=50..350) where cells are shaded according to the rule "cell (row, col) is dark if row + col is a prime number" using 1-based indexing from the top-left; draw thin black grid lines and clearly distinguish dark (#333) and light (#eee) cells. Add row numbers 1–5 to the left of the grid and column numbers 1–5 above it. In the right area (x=400..580), display a legend with two labeled swatches ("Dark: row+col prime", "Light: otherwise") and a text line stating the exact total count of dark cells in the form "Dark cells: N". All text must be at least 14px, readable, and must not overlap any other element or the grid. Output only the SVG code with no explanation, no markdown, and no surrounding text.
